name: Wizard Arena
summary:
Inspired by Mage Arena.

Say words to cast spells against other players. This game does not hold your hand, you will have to discover things by exploring on your own.

Basic spells: Fireball, protection, glacier, flare, discharge, disarm, illuminate, ascend.

Scrolls randomly spawn around the map containing new spells.
You have a spell book inside your chest that updates with each spell you cast.

Join our discord for any questions: https://discord.gg/75rTzdHNWk
